description: Delete one or more test-data iteration rows by NAME (e.g. "ITR-2") or id. Works at TEST CASE level (`entityType:"TC"` + `tcId`) and at SUITE level (`entityType:"SU"` + `suiteId`). The DEFAULT row is refused — to replace the default, first make another row the default with testdata_set_default_iteration. Use this to remove rows created by mistake. It reads the rows back after deleting and reports what remains.

entityType.description: TC = a test case's own test data; SU = suite-level test data. Default TC.

environmentType.description: Environment key from tc_list_environments (e.g. general, general_1).

iterations.description: Iteration names (e.g. ["ITR-2"]) or ids to delete.

suiteId.description: Suite id / SU-24 (required when entityType is SU).

tcId.description: Test case id / TC-123 (required when entityType is TC).

name: testdata_delete_iterations
title: Delete test-data iteration rows (test case or suite level)
